questions.prompt: At work, I feel mentally exhausted.
I struggle to find any enthusiasm for my work.
At work, I have trouble staying focused.
At work, I feel unable to control my emotions.
Are you exhausted in the morning at the thought of another day at work?
Do you have enough energy for family and friends during leisure time?

interpretation.low: Low burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms - Keep up the great work!
interpretation.moderate: Moderate burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms - Consider taking regular breaks and self-care.
interpretation.high: High burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms - Please consider reaching out to HR or a mental health professional.
